name: rule-control-reads-do-not-cover-writes
why: Control: the lead's reads and issue writes do not cover editing repository settings.

purposes: Track the work my discoboxes do in discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; file issues for work I hand to a discobox, and comment on issues. Never push, merge, or close anything, edit an issue's title or body, delete a comment, file an issue in another repository, or read secrets.
uses: Change discobox-ai/discobox's repository settings: set its default branch and main's branch protection.
